report: 图像中的微小噪声残留水平为 1.8932，属于生成图像的范围（P(Fake)=0.641）。这表明图像可能是通过生成算法创建的，而不是由相机传感器直接拍摄的。然而，这个单一的指标不足以作为确定性证据，因为降噪、锐化和重压缩操作也会改变这个值。此外，图像的压缩历史也未提供足够的信息来进一步降低不确定性。因此，基于现有证据，我们无法得出图像真实性的明确结论。

evidence.phenomenon: Whole-image noise-residual level 1.8932: the generated-imagery end of the G2 calibration band. Variance collapse detected; a band is an association measured on the calibration set, not a physical proof of origin.
evidence.reasoning: Whole-image residual micro-noise level 1.8932 (low). The G2 calibration set associates this band with generated imagery (fake median 2.0 vs real median 3.6). The number is one statistic of the whole image and says nothing about where in the image anything is. Denoising, sharpening and re-compression move it the same way, so on its own it is a weak signal, not proof of origin.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to generated-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.64); the generative reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 该指标衡量残差水平而非"不一致性"：G2 校准（格式配平，5 格）显示 Real 中位数 3.6 对 Fake 2.0，方向与原始"异常即伪造"的解释相反，且跨格式稳定（AUROC 0.15-0.23）。降噪、锐化与重压缩同样会改变该水平，故只应作为弱证据与校准似然配合使用。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（JPEG 压缩引入方差），不得按 AI-generated 解读；低 strength 侧（P(Fake)≈0.8）可作为弱证据使用。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Low residual micro-noise level — smooth, low-variance output of the kind the calibration set associates with generated imagery.
